paper.title: Algorithm 823: Implementing Scrambled Digital Sequences
paper.venue: ACM TOMS 29(2), pp. 95-109 (Jun 2003); paper text not checked in this wake (no paper search attempted)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 823.zip (scouted 2026-11-27, sha256 de5eaa5face30d4590a8679a94f0b830229771087afbdd4bdc1b75d11b3f9785). Fortran 77 tree 823/Fortran77/Dp/{Snied,Sniedx,Sfaur,Ssobol}/ each with Src/ (src.f, extra.f) and Drivers/ (driver.f, Makefile, res1, data1). The Snied variant is the one claimed here.

claim.location: Shipped driver Fortran77/Dp/Snied/Drivers/driver.f (program TSNIED). It sets DIMEN=2, ATMOST=2**12=4096, IFLAG=1 (Owen-type scrambling), calls GNNIED to generate 4096 scrambled Niederreiter points, and prints the running estimate EI = SUM/I of the Davis-Rabinowitz integrand (2) (product of |4x-2| over the two coordinates; exact value 1) at I = 512, 1024, 2048, 4096. The shipped reference output Drivers/Snied/res1 records those values; the claim is the final line, I = 4096.
claim.metric: EI = SUM/I at I = 4096 printed by TSNIED (Snied variant, IFLAG=1, DIMEN=2)
claim.paper_value: 0.9999468969847435 (shipped reference output res1; the paper text was not checked, so no printed table value was located)

values.name: EI at I=4096, Snied IFLAG=1, DIMEN=2

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The code is double precision and the value is a mean of 4096 terms, each of magnitude at most 2 (the product of two |4x-2| factors on [0,1]^2), so accumulated rounding is of order 1e-13. The reference is printed to 16 significant digits. 1e-9 absolute leaves about four orders of magnitude over rounding, yet is far below the change a different scrambling, sequence or generator-matrix bug makes (the res1 values at I=512, 1024 and 2048 differ from the I=4096 value by up to 3e-4).

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute (one GNNIED run of 4096 points in dimension 2, plus compile).
cost.data_size: None beyond the archive (about 67 KB zip).
cost.data_licence: Netlib TOMS code under the ACM licence of the archive; the rerun should record the licence it finds.

why: The shipped driver generates a scrambled Niederreiter sequence and evaluates a known test integral; reproducing the printed running estimate needs the full GNNIED generator-matrix and scrambling path to run, so the number cannot be obtained by reading the code.
